analysis.reason: 직전 3거래일 연속 관망 판독 유지. RSI는 40선 초반에서 48.1까지 회복했으나 여전히 중립 구간에 머물러 있다. MACD 히스토그램은 개선세를 보이나 아직 기준선 하단에 위치하며 추세 전환을 확정하기 어렵다. analysis.reasonEn: The wait-and-see read has now held for 3 consecutive sessions. RSI has recovered from the low 40s to 48.1 but remains in neutral territory. MACD histogram shows improvement but is still below the zero line, making a trend reversal uncertain. ADX at 15.5 indicates a lack of trend, and the volume ratio of 0.86 relative to the 5-day average lowers confidence in price movement. The 52-week position at 66.4% is in the mid-range, 33.6% below the 52-week high. The current price of $517.62 is near the SMA20 at $523.31 and EMA20 at $518.60, facing resistance. Sideways movement between the swing support at $498.93 and swing resistance at $533.74 is likely.
